name: Opus Momentum
strategy: Leveraged long US semis/Nasdaq momentum (TQQQ/SOXL/SMH/AMD/MU/AVGO) funded partly by short crypto perps riding the persistent BTC/ETH/SOL downtrend, weekly-reassessed with a cash buffer.

positions.thesis: Biotech is the strongest 1m momentum leader (+10.8% 1m, +11.4% 3m) as tech rolls over.
Healthcare momentum broad and durable (+7.4% 1m, +8.7% 3m); low-beta leadership.
Regional banks accelerating (+8.4% 1m, +9.6% 3m), a fresh momentum leg.
Financials trending (+4.5% 1m, +7.7% 3m); confirms the value/cyclical rotation.
Energy strongest 1w group (+4.7% 1w, +6.3% 1m); commodity momentum re-engaging.
Value leads growth on 3m (+9.5% 3m) with steady 1m gains; ride the style rotation.
Small-cap 3x carries strongest 3m trend (+16.7%); leveraged momentum away from broken semis.
Low-vol (+4.6% 1m, +1.0% 1w) dampens book variance during the regime shift.

reassessment_note: Week 1 desk (2026-07-18): Momentum regime broke out of semis/leveraged tech (SMH -10.8% 1m, SOXL -42% 1m, TQQQ -12.7% 1m) and into healthcare/biotech/banks/energy/value; rotating to current leaders per momentum discipline.
